description: The connected WeChat Service Account’s setup, for finishing or fixing the connection: the SERVER ADDRESS (URL), TOKEN and ENCODINGAESKEY the user pastes into WeChat (WeChat Developer Platform, the Service Account, Basic info, Domain and message push config, in Safe mode), whether WeChat has checked the address yet, when the last message arrived, and whether WeChat still accepts the AppID and AppSecret. WeChat refuses calls from any address that is not on the account’s API IP whitelist; when that is the problem the answer names the address to add. Use it when WeChat messages are not arriving or a reply fails. Relay the three setup values exactly; never ask the user for the AppSecret again, it is not shown. Free, 0 credits.
name: wechat_account
title: Read the WeChat account setup
